{
  "name": "prompt-marks",
  "displayName": "Prompt Marks",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "Marks your prompts in the transcript with a colored bar and tinted row, and jumps between them with Option+Up and Option+Down",
  "author": {
    "name": "Adam Caviness"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/adamcaviness/prompt-marks",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "transcript",
    "navigation",
    "prompts"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Prompt Marks: Enabled",
      "description": "Turns all of Prompt Marks on or off",
      "default": true
    },
    "styling": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Prompt Marks: Styling",
      "description": "Draws the accent bar and tinted row behind each prompt",
      "default": true
    },
    "navigation": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Prompt Marks: Navigation",
      "description": "Jumps between prompts with Option or Ctrl plus Up and Down",
      "default": true
    },
    "accent_color": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Prompt Marks: Accent color",
      "description": "Color of the bar left of each prompt; the row tint is mixed from it. Pick Custom to use the custom hex color.",
      "options": [
        "Purple",
        "Indigo",
        "Blue",
        "Teal",
        "Green",
        "Olive",
        "Amber",
        "Orange",
        "Red",
        "Pink",
        "Slate",
        "Custom"
      ],
      "default": "Purple"
    },
    "custom_color": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Prompt Marks: Custom color",
      "description": "Hex color such as #5b2a86, used when Accent color is Custom",
      "default": "#5b2a86"
    },
    "tint_strength": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Prompt Marks: Tint strength",
      "description": "Percent of the accent color mixed into the terminal background behind each prompt",
      "default": 22,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100
    }
  }
}
